legend: You are given $N$, $A$ and $B$. Print the sum of all integers from $1$ to $N$ whose digit sum is between $A$ and $B$ (inclusive).
input: One line with three integers $N$, $A$, $B$ ($1 \le N \le 10^4$, $1 \le A \le B \le 36$).
notes: Up to $20$, the numbers with digit sum between $2$ and $5$ are $2, 3, 4, 5, 11, 12, 13, 14, 20$; their sum is $84$.
